title: New playbook: SNAP recertification
reason: 4 students forwarded recertification notices and handled them without a playbook.

declaration.title: Keeping SNAP: recertification
declaration.purpose: Carry a student through SNAP recertification so benefits do not stop.

steps.text: Your SNAP recertification notice came in. Finishing it on time keeps your benefits from stopping.
Get these ready. Anything in your vault is checked off.
documents: Proof of income for the last 30 days

steps.text: Submit the renewal at benefits.ohio.gov before the date on your notice.
If they schedule an interview, tell me the time and I will remind you.
steps.on_timeout: Call your county Job and Family Services office to check on your renewal.

recovery: If the date passes, I can help you reapply and ask about the gap.

journey.goal: A student who forwards a SNAP recertification notice is walked through renewal before the deadline, with documents lined up and reminders set.
forbidden: a message fails the tone rubric
something is sent without the student's approval

falsification.plant: a step of kind "submit" with no student confirmation
